label: Contract pharmacy access
description: Limits what a drug maker may do to hold back 340B drugs from a pharmacy that works under contract with a covered entity, or to put conditions on sending them.

label: Payer and PBM non-discrimination
description: Limits what an insurer, a pharmacy benefit manager or another payer may do to a 340B covered entity or its pharmacy, such as paying less for a 340B drug or leaving the pharmacy out of a network.

label: Reporting
description: Requires covered entities, or others, to report 340B figures to the state, or a state office to publish them.

label: Medicaid
description: Sets rules for 340B drugs in the state's Medicaid program, such as how they are billed or paid for.

label: Use of savings
description: Says how a covered entity is to use what it earns or saves through 340B.

label: Study
description: Orders a study, a task force or a one-time report on 340B.

label: Other
description: Names 340B and does something the kinds above do not cover.
